neon_glowsticks.configuration.title: Neon Glowsticks
neon_glowsticks.configuration.glowSecond: How long a cracked glowstick glows. It dims during the last minute.
neon_glowsticks.configuration.lightLevel: Block light level around a thrown glowstick (a torch gives 14).
neon_glowsticks.configuration.lightBlock: Thrown glowsticks place invisible light that follows them. Without it they still glow, but the world stays dark and mobs keep spawning.
neon_glowsticks.configuration.coloredLig: Tint the blocks around a glowstick with its color.
How strongly the blocks are tinted.
Reach of the colored light in blocks.
neon_glowsticks.configuration.maxColored: At most this many glowsticks (the nearest ones) cast colored light at once.
neon_glowsticks.configuration.halo.toolt: Draw a soft glow around glowsticks.
